title: Injectable platelet-rich fibrin for corneal epithelium healing: An in vivo confocal microscopy study after crosslinking

species: human: patients aged 15-40 years with progressive keratoconus treated by epithelium-off CXL (retrospective comparative study, Ankara, Turkey, 2021-2023); diabetes, autoimmune/collagen disorders, other eye disease, concurrent treatment, contact-lens wear, nonadherence and incomplete data were exclusion criteria

wound.diameter_basis: stated: '8 mm of the central corneal epithelium was gently scraped using a blunt spatula' after a 30-s application of 20% alcohol (Methods, Surgical technique); measured hour-0 areas are not used for geometry (protocol 1.1.0 section 5)
wound.method: epithelium-off accelerated CXL: proparacaine 0.5%, 20% alcohol 30 s, 8 mm central epithelium scraped with a blunt spatula; 0.1% riboflavin with HPMC (VibeX Rapid) every 2 min for 10 min; UVA (Avedro KXL) 9 mW/cm2 for 10 min (5.4 J/cm2) with riboflavin every 2 min; BSS rinse, silicone hydrogel bandage contact lens, one drop of moxifloxacin 0.5%

groups.description: 'i-PRF-nonapplied group (n=25)': no i-PRF injection and no sham injection described; standard post-operative regimen only (stated for all patients): bandage contact lens replaced daily, topical moxifloxacin 0.5% and loteprednol etabonate 0.5% four times daily, sodium hyaluronate 0.15% artificial tears every 3 h until epithelial healing, then lens removed, moxifloxacin stopped and loteprednol continued four times daily for 1 month

'i-PRF-applied group (n=26)': autologous injectable platelet-rich fibrin (10 ml antecubital venous blood in additive-free i-PRF tubes, 700 rpm for 3 min), 'subconjunctival injections of 0.1 ml of i-PRF close to the limbus, administered from four quadrants' immediately after CXL, plus the same standard post-operative regimen

series.notes: Table 2 (t2) 'Epithelial defect size (mm2)', column 'i-PRF-nonapplied group (n=25) mean ± SD'; leading mean of each 'mean ± SD' cell, mm2, normalized by the series' own hour-0 mean; original labels 'Postoperative immediate', 'Postoperative day 1', 'Postoperative day 2', 'Postoperative day 3' -> 0, 24, 48, 72 h (protocol 1.1.0 section 4); hour 0 measured immediately after the CXL procedure (Methods); fluorescein, cobalt-blue slit-lamp photographs, defect margins outlined in ImageJ by two ophthalmologists masked to group, scale set from the horizontal corneal diameter; every cited cell is declared 'mean ± SD' by its column header; n = patients per the Table 2 header (eyes per patient not stated); group means because no per-patient rows are available (Data Availability deposit doi:10.7910/DVN/ESKFGO not publicly accessible on 2026-10-28); control: standard post-operative regimen only (moxifloxacin, loteprednol, sodium hyaluronate tears, bandage contact lens), no investigational agent (protocol 1.1.0 section 6)
